name: eg-drugs
description: 27K+ Egyptian medicines dataset with Arabic & English names, active ingredients, manufacturers, prices, barcodes, and uses. Available in CSV, JSON, SQLite, SQL, and via a free public REST API.

name: eg-pharmacies
description: 45K+ Egyptian pharmacies dataset covering all 27 governorates, with Arabic names, addresses, license numbers, and Google Maps links. Available in CSV and JSON.

name: img2pdf
description: A fast, private, browser-native web app to convert JPG, PNG, and WEBP images into custom PDF documents with zero server uploads. Built with React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, @dnd-kit, and pdf-lib.

name: pixel-bouquet
description: ✨ Send a virtual flower to someone you care about. A beautiful, nostalgic experience combining pixel-art bouquets with heartfelt, private letters.

name: quran-pro
description: A comprehensive Islamic web application built with Next.js 16. Features include a digital Mushaf, Quran audio streaming from over 230 reciters, complete Hadith collections, daily Azkar, Islamic radio, and multi-language support.

name: swot
description: Identify email addresses or domains names that belong to colleges or universities. Help automate the process of approving or rejecting academic discounts.

name: tahane
description: An elegant Eid al-Adha greeting card generator and builder. Allows users to customize designs with their names and photos in real-time, and features a visual editor powered by OpenCV.js and React Konva for mapping layout configurations.

name: Wanderlust-Adventure
description: A modern travel landing page showcasing clean UI, smooth animations, and responsive design — perfect for inspiring wanderlust!

name: wedding-invitation-
description: A beautiful web app allowing couples to seamlessly create and share highly customizable, animated digital invitations for their special day. 💍
